historical_event.name: Chernobyl nuclear disaster
historical_event.description: The world's worst nuclear disaster occurs when the fourth reactor at the Chernobyl nuclear power station in the Soviet Union explodes, resulting in 31 deaths and radioactive contamination spreading to much of Western Europe.

science_daily.title: Blood Vessels Found in T. Rex Bones Are Rewriting Dinosaur Science
science_daily.summary: Dinosaur DNA may still be out of reach, but scientists are uncovering something almost as exciting—ancient blood vessels hidden inside fossilized bones. In a massive Tyrannosaurus rex nicknamed Scotty, researchers discovered a network of preserved blood vessels using synchrotron X-ray imaging, revealing details about dinosaur healing processes from 66 million years ago. The finding suggests bones with injuries may better preserve soft tissues, guiding future fossil discoveries.
